what_this_is_not: A HEURISTIC DIAGNOSTIC at one world. Differencing along the alpha axis removes the penalty's constant part and its measured drift, but NOT the threshold overshoot O_alpha nor the finite-time information residual R_tau; neither is bounded in this corpus, and either can move the slope in either direction. So this is not an upper bound on 1/Gamma and not an independent test of the rate. The four-point baseline in log(1/alpha) spans only 2.30 to 4.61, and the LEVELS are not testable on this panel at all.
